The '''Southmoon Ruins''' is an area of ancient troll ruins, in [[Tanaris]], now taken over by the [[Dunemaul]] [[ogre]]s from their stronghold [[Dunemaul Compound]]. [[Eastmoon Ruins]] is also occupied by Dunemaul ogres.

Southmoon Ruins are just northeast of [[Uldum]].

List of mobs:
*[[Dunemaul Ogre]]
*[[Dunemaul Ogre Mage]]
*[[Dunemaul Warlock]]
*[[Omgorn the Lost]] (wanders)
